title: IMPORTCSV and IMPORTTEXT spill parsed 2-D arrays, return #CALC! on empty results, and preflight scalar argument errors in order
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, IMPORTCSV(path, [skip_rows], [take_rows], [text_only], [locale]) and IMPORTTEXT(path, [delimiter], [skip_rows], [take_rows], [encoding], [text_only], [locale]) preflight scalar errors and numeric option types in argument order before validating paths (#VALUE! on relative paths, folders, or unreadable files; #CALC! on empty files or zero rows remaining after negative/positive skip_rows and take_rows). IMPORTTEXT accepts multi-character delimiters (default tab), ascending fixed-width arrays ({1,3}), and Windows code-page numbers overridden by BOM, and both convert fields under the locale number-text grammar unless text_only is TRUE. Matches 3,021/3,021 IMPORTCSV and 3,149/3,149 IMPORTTEXT full-bank rows, plus 228 fixture cases.
basis: Measured across all 3,021 IMPORTCSV and 3,149 IMPORTTEXT full-bank rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence admit2-answers-{importcsv,importtext}-*.json) and 228 live Excel 16.0.20527 file-import cases in crates/calc-func/tests/fixtures/import/excel-answers.json.

evidence.note: argument preflight, delimiter/fixed-width slicing, and locale conversion
